thought.summary: Import contacts from Gmail to reduce onboarding drop-off
thought.text: What if we just let users import contacts straight from Gmail? Could kill the onboarding drop-off.

cases.notes: Observed: engine minted a duplicate 'Onboarding improvements' bucket. Embedding sim to existing centroid was 0.640 vs create_threshold 0.65 (near-miss), AND the organizer proposed the identical bucket name — name-collision guard added to engine. Threshold tuning itself is a Phase 4 measured decision.

cases.notes: Observed: duplicate bucket minted; sim 0.508-0.518 to existing centroid. Same-topic short thoughts with different surface vocabulary score moderately on text-embedding-3-large@1024 — dataset should accumulate more of these before threshold changes.

cases.notes: Organizer classed 'we should test X' as a task (drove task precision to 0.61 in the first live eval). Ambiguous phrasing: experiment proposal vs commitment. Human adjudication: experiment ideas belong to the topic bucket unless a concrete owner/deliverable is stated.
